top.title: Create the social accounts (Mastodon, Bluesky) and hand them to Aros — chamber#1, open 6 days 19 hours, the oldest item on this desk. Nothing on this desk has been waiting a full week yet; this item crosses one week tonight at 22:17:48 UTC, the first ever to do so. It sits at the top because the item that used to (the agent GitHub account and its token) was ranked partly on the argument that the missing pull-request scope is what stops corrections being accepted, and qlever-dir#9 was filed, fixed and merged without that scope. chamber#1 is the phase exit — every bet in the strategy needs an audience, and there is none

others.title: Create a GitHub account for Aros, invite it to the org, and mint its token with contents + issues + pull-requests + repo-metadata scope — one action closes chamber#3 (he files issues from your account, which guardrail 8 forbids, and it is the standing violation on this list) and chamber#6 (no pull requests, no topics, no descriptions, no security settings, no comments on pull requests). Open 5 days 15 hours and 5 days 13 hours

Enable private vulnerability reporting on the four public repos — chamber#5, open 5 days 14 hours. Re-checked 2026-07-25 17:26 UTC: still false on all four. Your new SECURITY.md on the chamber branch gives a reporting path that does not depend on it, which fixes the worst half; the Code of Conduct's enforcement link still routes to the disabled feature. Verify your own fix with: gh api /repos/retinue-os/<repo>/private-vulnerability-reporting — it answers without admin scope

Merge (or reject) the branch claude/aros-issues-triage-goei5k on this chamber repo — it replaces the GUARDRAILS.md §3 CI row (chamber#7, open 5 days 13 hours) and adds SECURITY.md. Still unmerged with no pull request at 17:26; this repository has never had one. One change before merging: the row it adopts is Aros's own earlier wording, and its clause about the gateway's security-critical paths being untested is false as written — path traversal and SPARQL-injection containment are exercised in four test files. The corrected sentence ("endpoint authorization is untested by construction: no test constructs the gateway's request handler") is in a comment on chamber#7, posted 2026-07-25 16:40 UTC

Fix or triage the two security findings — retinue#15 (credentials inherited by agent subsessions; this session carries a repo-write token, a billable API key, a gateway master key and a database password) and retinue#19 (agent can self-approve a verify-policy send). Open 4 days 8 hours and 3 days 21 hours. Both unfixed, so the affected claims stay withdrawn from positioning.md

Merge the two claim corrections that follow from those findings — retinue#26 and retinue#27, open 1 day 10 hours and 1 day 3 hours. Between them the false or unscoped sentence appears in nine public places (README, comparison.md, review.md, .env.example, a gateway docstring, an agent-facing skill file). No new prose needed: the correct wording already exists elsewhere in the same repo in both cases

Create retinue-os/.github and set the org and repo descriptions — chamber#4, open 5 days 14 hours. Draft text is paste-ready in writing/org-profile-README.md; three of four public repos still have no description and no repo in the org has a topic. Its project's expected_by date was today, and it arrives unmet

Allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests — retinue#4, open 5 days 6 hours. check-signal-cli pushes its bump branch and then cannot open the PR, so the automation completes and delivers nothing. Same missing permission as chamber#6, through a different door

Decide the two questions on the privacy thread pushed to your dashboard: whether to purge this chamber repo's history of text redacted on 2026-07-20, and the deliberate-disclosure question, unread since 2026-07-19 21:33 UTC — 5 days 19 hours, the second-oldest thing on this desk. Deliberately not described here or in any public file. If you do nothing, the redaction stands and nothing degrades

Triage the remaining defects in the indexing mechanism the lead story rests on — qlever-dir#8 (blank nodes collide across files; you proposed skolemizing per graph, which Aros answered 2026-07-25) and #10 (a directory created after startup is never watched, which is exactly how the framework's own boot emitters write). #9 in that set is closed and its fix is verified

retinue#28 is on main rather than on a branch: PR #22 merged 2026-07-25 15:12 UTC with both items unaddressed — docs/triple-stores.md states the _generated indexing as unconditional, and the model slug is not injective. Aros corrected his own suggested fix in the thread; take the corrected one

review.md is stale on tests and CI: recommendation #2 is done and six statements are now false — retinue#3, open 5 days 13 hours. Two items on its edit list are struck as superseded, with replacements in the thread; the counts it proposed have gone stale twice, so reword without counts rather than refreshing them

Two docs branches are pushed and cannot be opened as PRs: retinue:docs/link-provenance-piece and retinue:docs/calibrate-reindex-latency (retinue#2, open 5 days 18 hours). Merge them directly, or grant the scope above and Aros opens them as reviewable PRs
